test.create_query: CREATE TABLE ts_gap (shape LowCardinality(String), id UInt32, timestamp DateTime64(3), value Float64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (shape, id, timestamp)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO ts_gap SELECT 'contiguous', id, toDateTime64(m * 60, 3), m FROM (SELECT number % 200 AS id, intDiv(number, 200) AS m FROM numbers(200 * 6200))
INSERT INTO ts_gap SELECT 'gap', id, toDateTime64(m * 60, 3), m FROM (SELECT number % 200 AS id, intDiv(number, 200) AS m FROM numbers(200 * 10081)) WHERE m < 3100 OR m >= 6981
INSERT INTO ts_gap SELECT 'late_start', id, toDateTime64(m * 60, 3), m FROM (SELECT number % 200 AS id, intDiv(number, 200) AS m FROM numbers(200 * 10081)) WHERE m >= 4000
INSERT INTO ts_gap SELECT 'gap_sparse', id, toDateTime64(m * 60, 3), m FROM (SELECT number % 200 AS id, intDiv(number, 200) AS m FROM numbers(200 * 10081)) WHERE m < 1500 OR m >= 8581
INSERT INTO ts_gap SELECT 'every_2nd', id, toDateTime64(m * 60, 3), m FROM (SELECT number % 200 AS id, intDiv(number, 200) AS m FROM numbers(200 * 10081)) WHERE m % 2 = 0
INSERT INTO ts_gap SELECT 'dense', id, toDateTime64(q * 15, 3), q FROM (SELECT number % 200 AS id, intDiv(number, 200) AS q FROM numbers(200 * 6200 * 4))

SELECT id, timeSeriesLastToGridMerge(0, 604800, 60, 60)(s) FROM (SELECT id, timestamp >= toDateTime64(6981 * 60, 3) AS late, timeSeriesLastToGridState(0, 604800, 60, 60)(timestamp, value) AS s FROM ts_gap WHERE shape = 'gap' GROUP BY id, late ORDER BY id, late DESC) GROUP BY id FORMAT Null SETTINGS query_plan_remove_redundant_sorting = 0
